title: Supercharacter theory and applications to Ramanujan sums over a finite Frobenius ring
summary: The theory of Ramanujan sums has been playing a fundamental role in several subfields of mathematics. They appear in the theory of special values of zeta functions, spectral graph theory, representation theory, and analytic number theory. Recent work has shown that classical Ramanujan sums can also be interpreted as a super-Fourier transform via the theory of supercharacters for the ring $\mathbb{Z}/n$.
